claim: Before 2017 Constantia and Durbanville were free-floating wards inside the Coastal Region with no district above them.
because: Durbanville (a ward since 1989) and Philadelphia were wards of the Tygerberg district. The June 2017 Cape Town district replaced Tygerberg and also took in the district-less wards Constantia and Hout Bay. Only Constantia and Hout Bay were without a district before 2017.
fix: Before 2017 Durbanville and Philadelphia were wards of the Tygerberg district, while Constantia and Hout Bay were wards directly under the Coastal Region with no district; the Cape Town district replaced Tygerberg and gathered all four.
